adopting-strategic-outcome-based-backlog.en: Shift backlog items from output commitments to explicit outcome hypotheses, making learning and impact visible in everyday prioritization. In service organizations: adopting service queues framed around client outcomes, not request types.
adopting-strategic-outcome-based-backlog.text: Skift backlogpunkter fra outputtilsagn til eksplicitte outcome-hypoteser, så læring og effekt bliver synlige i den daglige prioritering. I serviceorganisationer: indfør servicekøer, der er formuleret efter kundens outcomes, ikke efter typer af henvendelser.

applying-evidence-based-management-ebm-f.text: Brug Evidence-Based Management (EBM) til at opbygge evner

applying-evidence-based-management-ebm-f.en: Use a small set of meaningful measures in regular reviews to guide learning and improvement, rather than managing by objective.
applying-evidence-based-management-ebm-f.text: Brug en lille mængde meningsfulde målinger i jævnlige reviews til at styre læring og forbedring, i stedet for at styre efter mål.

continuously-integrating-work-across-tea.text: Integrér løbende arbejdet på tværs af teams

continuously-integrating-work-across-tea.en: Reduce integration risk and delays by integrating work continuously across all contributing teams and agents, rather than batching and reconciling it late. In software contexts, this is commonly realized through practices such as trunk-based development, monorepos, and continuous integration as a practice (not a tool).
continuously-integrating-work-across-tea.text: Reducér integrationsrisiko og forsinkelser ved at integrere arbejdet løbende på tværs af alle bidragende teams og agenter, i stedet for at samle det i bunker og afstemme det sent. I softwaresammenhæng realiseres det typisk med praksisser som trunk-based development, monorepos og continuous integration som praksis (ikke som værktøj).

de-emphasizing-individual-performance-in.en: Reduce incentive structures that drive local optimization at the expense of system performance.
de-emphasizing-individual-performance-in.text: Reducér incitamentsstrukturer, der driver lokal optimering på bekostning af systemets ydeevne.

decentralizing-cross-cutting-concerns-th.en: Decentralize ownership of cross-cutting concerns (such as architectural guidelines, standards, and policies) by enabling self-organizing communities to evolve practices collaboratively, reducing dependency on centralized coordination.
decentralizing-cross-cutting-concerns-th.text: Decentralisér ejerskabet af tværgående hensyn (som arkitekturretningslinjer, standarder og politikker) ved at lade selvorganiserende communities udvikle praksis i fællesskab, så afhængigheden af central koordination mindskes.

designing-tailwind-career-paths.summary.en: Create career systems that reward capability growth and multi-learning to support employees' contribution to valuable outcomes.
designing-tailwind-career-paths.summary.text: Skab karrieresystemer, der belønner evneudvikling og multi-learning og understøtter medarbejdernes bidrag til værdifulde outcomes.

embedding-ai-assisted-multi-learning-int.text: Indbyg (AI-understøttet) multi-learning i det daglige arbejde

embedding-ai-assisted-multi-learning-int.en: Use AI to lower the cost of learning new skills while delivering, expanding what teams can responsibly take on.
embedding-ai-assisted-multi-learning-int.text: Brug AI til at sænke prisen for at lære nye kompetencer, mens man leverer, så det udvides, hvad teams ansvarligt kan tage på sig.

enabling-team-self-design.name.text: Gør det muligt for teams at designe sig selv

enabling-team-self-design.summary.en: Enable teams to redesign their own composition and boundaries within clear strategic and mandate constraints, increasing ownership and fitness for purpose.
enabling-team-self-design.summary.text: Giv teams mulighed for at redesigne deres egen sammensætning og grænser inden for klare strategiske rammer og mandatrammer, så ejerskab og fit for purpose øges.

expanding-and-sharing-the-definition-of-.en: Expanding and Sharing the Definition of Done Across Teams
expanding-and-sharing-the-definition-of-.text: Udvid og del Definition of Done på tværs af teams

expanding-and-sharing-the-definition-of-.en: Continuously broaden the Definition of Done to include real completeness and quality, reducing hidden work, handoffs, and late surprises.
expanding-and-sharing-the-definition-of-.text: Udvid løbende Definition of Done, så den omfatter reel færdighed og kvalitet, og skjult arbejde, overleveringer og sene overraskelser mindskes.

expanding-the-product-definition.summary.en: Deliberately broaden what the organization considers "the product" so teams orient around real customer outcomes rather than narrow components or tasks.
expanding-the-product-definition.summary.text: Udvid bevidst, hvad organisationen anser for »produktet«, så teams orienterer sig efter reelle kundeoutcomes frem for snævre komponenter eller opgaver.

expanding-units-toward-end-to-end-outcom.en: Expanding Units Toward End-to-End Outcome Ownership
expanding-units-toward-end-to-end-outcom.text: Udvid enheder mod end-to-end-ejerskab af outcomes

expanding-units-toward-end-to-end-outcom.en: Broaden team mandates so they can complete work from intent to realized value. In practice, this often exposes the need to simplify the organization by eliminating separate units responsible for "preparing" or "finishing" work, resulting in a more coherent and adaptive org design.
expanding-units-toward-end-to-end-outcom.text: Udvid teamenes mandater, så de kan føre arbejdet fra intention til realiseret værdi. I praksis afslører det ofte et behov for at forenkle organisationen ved at fjerne særskilte enheder, der »forbereder« eller »færdiggør« arbejde, hvilket giver et mere sammenhængende og adaptivt organisationsdesign.

forming-a-team-of-teams.summary.en: Create a lightweight structure where teams align around shared goals while retaining autonomy in execution.
forming-a-team-of-teams.summary.text: Skab en let struktur, hvor teams stemmer af efter fælles mål, men bevarer autonomi i udførelsen.

holding-multi-team-product-backlog-refin.text: Hold refinement af produktbacklog på tværs af teams

holding-multi-team-product-backlog-refin.en: Bring multiple teams together regularly to build a shared understanding of upcoming work, risks, and coordination before execution.
holding-multi-team-product-backlog-refin.text: Saml flere teams jævnligt for at opbygge en fælles forståelse af det kommende arbejde, risici og koordination, før arbejdet udføres.

holding-product-level-reviews.summary.en: Inspect integrated product outcomes rather than isolated team outputs, keeping learning at the right level. In service organizations: reviewing end-to-end service outcomes, not departmental metrics. This Kata is often realized through formats such as Sprint Review Bazaars, where stakeholders and customers actively explore working solutions and provide direct feedback instead of passively consuming presentations.
holding-product-level-reviews.summary.text: Inspicér integrerede produktoutcomes frem for isolerede teamoutputs, så læringen bliver på det rette niveau. I serviceorganisationer: review af end-to-end-serviceoutcomes, ikke afdelingsmålinger. Denne kata realiseres ofte i formater som Sprint Review Bazaars, hvor interessenter og kunder aktivt udforsker fungerende løsninger og giver direkte feedback i stedet for passivt at modtage præsentationer.

implementing-beyond-budgeting.summary.en: Loosen rigid annual planning constraints so resources can move as learning and priorities change.
implementing-beyond-budgeting.summary.text: Løsn de stive rammer for den årlige planlægning, så ressourcer kan flytte sig, efterhånden som læring og prioriteter ændrer sig.

merging-product-backlogs.summary.en: Reduce fragmentation by consolidating competing backlogs into fewer shared ones, forcing real prioritization at the level where value is created.
merging-product-backlogs.summary.text: Reducér fragmenteringen ved at samle konkurrerende backlogs i færre fælles, så der tvinges en reel prioritering på det niveau, hvor værdien skabes.

minimizing-distance-to-customers.summary.en: Create regular, direct contact between teams and customers so decisions are informed by reality rather than assumptions or proxies.
minimizing-distance-to-customers.summary.text: Skab jævn, direkte kontakt mellem teams og kunder, så beslutninger bygger på virkeligheden frem for antagelser eller stedfortrædere.

moving-toward-multi-team-cross-functiona.en: Moving Toward Multi-Team, Cross-Functional Line Management
moving-toward-multi-team-cross-functiona.text: Bevæg dig mod tværfunktionel linjeledelse af flere teams

moving-toward-multi-team-cross-functiona.en: Shift management focus from individual teams to multi-team value areas, enabling coordination and learning across boundaries.
moving-toward-multi-team-cross-functiona.text: Flyt ledelsens fokus fra enkelte teams til værdiområder med flere teams, så koordination og læring kan ske på tværs af grænser.

organizing-around-products-not-projects..en: Replace temporary project slices with long-lived ownership of products, preserving learning and accountability over time.
organizing-around-products-not-projects..text: Erstat midlertidige projektudsnit med langvarigt ejerskab af produkter, så læring og ansvar bevares over tid.

people.starModel.definition.en: The skills, mindsets, and capacities needed: how the organization recruits, develops, and grows people to match its strategic needs.
people.starModel.definition.text: De kompetencer, mindsets og kapaciteter, der er brug for: hvordan organisationen rekrutterer, udvikler og vokser sine medarbejdere, så de matcher dens strategiske behov.

processes.starModel.definition.en: How work and information flow: governance routines, planning and budgeting cycles, and decision-making processes.
processes.starModel.definition.text: Hvordan arbejde og information flyder: styringsrutiner, planlægnings- og budgetcyklusser og beslutningsprocesser.

re-centering-product-ownership-on-strate.en: Re-Centering Product Ownership on Strategy and Outcomes
re-centering-product-ownership-on-strate.text: Flyt produktejerskabet tilbage til strategi og outcomes

re-centering-product-ownership-on-strate.en: Position product ownership where strategic intent and value meet, with responsibility for outcomes rather than team-level delivery coordination. This requires avoiding team-level local product ownership and introducing shared or unified product ownership structures.
re-centering-product-ownership-on-strate.text: Placér produktejerskabet dér, hvor strategisk intention og værdi mødes, med ansvar for outcomes frem for koordinering af leverancer på teamniveau. Det kræver, at man undgår lokalt produktejerskab i de enkelte teams og indfører fælles eller samlede strukturer for produktejerskab.

redefining-the-manager-role-around-capab.en: Redefining the Manager Role Around Capability-Building and System Stewardship
redefining-the-manager-role-around-capab.text: Gentænk lederrollen omkring evneopbygning og systemansvar

redefining-the-manager-role-around-capab.en: Shift managers away from issuing instructions toward growing people and expanding mandates—developing the capabilities and judgment required for broader, end-to-end ownership while stewarding the system that surrounds the work.
redefining-the-manager-role-around-capab.text: Flyt lederne væk fra at give instruktioner og hen mod at udvikle mennesker og udvide mandater — at opbygge de evner og den dømmekraft, der skal til for bredere end-to-end-ejerskab, mens de passer på det system, der omgiver arbejdet.

rewards.starModel.definition.en: How people are motivated and steered: compensation, promotions, recognition, and other formal and informal incentives.
rewards.starModel.definition.text: Hvordan mennesker motiveres og styres: løn, forfremmelser, anerkendelse og andre formelle og uformelle incitamenter.

sharing-ownership-across-teams.name.text: Del ejerskab på tværs af teams

sharing-ownership-across-teams.summary.en: Expand technical ownership boundaries so teams can improve and fix issues without waiting on specialists or gatekeepers. In the software development context, this implies allowing the teams to work across the entire codebase. In service organizations: sharing ownership of processes, policies, or case handling.
sharing-ownership-across-teams.summary.text: Udvid de tekniske ejerskabsgrænser, så teams kan forbedre og rette fejl uden at vente på specialister eller gatekeepere. I softwareudvikling betyder det, at teamene må arbejde i hele kodebasen. I serviceorganisationer: delt ejerskab af processer, politikker eller sagsbehandling.

sharing-the-same-cadence-across-teams.na.en: Sharing the Same Cadence Across Teams
sharing-the-same-cadence-across-teams.na.text: Del den samme kadence på tværs af teams

sharing-the-same-cadence-across-teams.su.en: Create transparency for doing and inspecting the work in a shared rhythm for planning, review, and learning.
sharing-the-same-cadence-across-teams.su.text: Skab gennemsigtighed i at udføre og inspicere arbejdet i en fælles rytme for planlægning, review og læring.

slicing-work-vertically.summary.en: Practice breaking work into end-to-end increments that deliver learning and value, not partial progress.
slicing-work-vertically.summary.text: Øv dig i at dele arbejdet i end-to-end-inkrementer, der giver læring og værdi og ikke blot delvis fremdrift.

strategy.starModel.definition.en: The outcomes the organization is designed to achieve are derived from the strategy and are used as the benchmark for all design choices.
strategy.starModel.definition.text: De outcomes, organisationen er designet til at opnå, udledes af strategien og bruges som målestok for alle designvalg.

structure.starModel.definition.en: How power and authority are distributed: roles, units, reporting lines, and the basic architecture of who reports to whom.
structure.starModel.definition.text: Hvordan magt og autoritet er fordelt: roller, enheder, rapporteringslinjer og den grundlæggende arkitektur for, hvem der rapporterer til hvem.

using-obeya-for-org-topology-evolution.n.en: Using Obeya for Org Topology Evolution
using-obeya-for-org-topology-evolution.n.text: Brug Obeya til udviklingen af org topologien

using-obeya-for-org-topology-evolution.s.en: Use a shared decision space to connect strategy, evidence, and organizational design constraints, enabling deliberate topology evolution rather than merely tracking delivery.
using-obeya-for-org-topology-evolution.s.text: Brug et fælles beslutningsrum til at forbinde strategi, evidens og organisationsdesignets begrænsninger, så topologien udvikles bevidst i stedet for blot at følge leverancerne.

using-synchronous-team-work-to-expand-ca.en: Using Synchronous Team Work to Expand Capability and Ownership
using-synchronous-team-work-to-expand-ca.text: Brug synkront teamarbejde til at udvide evner og ejerskab

using-synchronous-team-work-to-expand-ca.en: Apply pairing, mobbing, and other forms of real synchronous work across role, team and functional boundaries to deliberately grow skills and reduce reliance on specialists or handoffs.
using-synchronous-team-work-to-expand-ca.text: Brug parprogrammering, mobbing og andre former for ægte synkront arbejde på tværs af roller, teams og funktioner til bevidst at vokse kompetencer og mindske afhængigheden af specialister eller overleveringer.

volunteering-for-work.summary.en: Enable individuals and teams to pull work where value is highest, rather than relying on predefined assignments. This kata increases organizational flexibility and shared ownership, and can be enacted through deliberate self-selection mechanisms (e.g., Open Space–style sessions).
volunteering-for-work.summary.text: Giv enkeltpersoner og teams mulighed for at trække arbejde derhen, hvor værdien er størst, i stedet for at være afhængige af forudbestemte opgaver. Denne kata øger organisationens fleksibilitet og det fælles ejerskab og kan gennemføres med bevidste selvvalgsmekanismer (fx sessioner i Open Space-stil).
